description: List every symbology this server can generate (35 formats), grouped by family, with a one-line summary and sample data for each. Call this first when you are unsure which "type" to pass to generate_barcode. Optionally narrow by family (e.g. "EAN / UPC", "2D Barcodes") or category ("linear", "stacked", "2d").

category.description: Restrict to one structural class of symbology.

family.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the family name, e.g. "Code 128", "2D", "EAN".

name: list_barcode_types
title: List barcode types
